en_title: Microsoft Updates Xbox PC App, Says It's 60% Faster
cn_title: 微软更新XBOX PC应用，称速度提升60%
opus_summary: 微软更新了XBOX PC应用，称其启动速度最高提升60%，页面加载和应用内窗口打开速度也有所提升。更新还改进了游戏库、搜索及社交功能，并提供深色和浅色模式。更新将先向XBOX Insider用户推出，再扩大适用范围。

paragraphs.en: Microsoft has updated the Xbox PC app so it’s faster and simpler, it said.
paragraphs.cn: 微软表示，已更新XBOX PC应用，使其速度更快、操作更简单。

paragraphs.en: The Xbox PC app, available on PC, web, and cloud, launches up to 60% faster and makes it easier to find games, Jason Beaumont, VP, Xbox Experiences, said in a blog post. The changes are being rolled out to Xbox Insiders first, before wider availability.
paragraphs.cn: XBOX体验部门副总裁Jason Beaumont在一篇博客文章中表示，可在PC、网页和云端使用的XBOX PC应用启动速度最高提升60%，也让查找游戏变得更加容易。这些更新将先向XBOX Insiders推出，之后再更广泛地开放。

paragraphs.en: Specifically, pages like Home, Store, and Game Pass load up to 50% faster, and in-app windows open up to 65% faster. But it’s worth noting that these results are based on Microsoft’s internal testing, and may be different for you depending on your device and internet connection.
paragraphs.cn: 具体来说，主页、商店和Game Pass等页面的加载速度最高提升50%，应用内窗口的打开速度最高提升65%。但值得注意的是，这些结果基于微软的内部测试，你的实际体验可能因设备和网络连接而有所不同。

paragraphs.en: As for making it easier to find and play games, your cloud games are in one place, there’s more room to browse on larger screens (particularly helpful for desktop mode on PCs and larger displays), and the ability to choose between dark and light modes.
paragraphs.cn: 至于让查找和游玩游戏变得更容易，你的云游戏集中在一处，较大的屏幕上有更多浏览空间（这对PC的桌面模式和较大的显示器尤其有帮助），还可以在深色和浅色模式之间进行选择。

paragraphs.en: Elsewhere, Microsoft is bringing the refreshed look of the Xbox PC app to Xbox cloud gaming apps on supported TVs and VR headsets.
paragraphs.cn: 此外，微软正将XBOX PC应用更新后的界面带到受支持的电视和VR头显上的XBOX云游戏应用中。

paragraphs.en: “These updates are another step toward making Xbox easier to use, more responsive, and more familiar wherever you choose to play,” Beaumont said. “We’ll continue listening to player feedback and improving over time.”
paragraphs.cn: Beaumont说：「这些更新让我们朝着让XBOX更易用、响应更迅速，并让你无论选择在哪里游玩都能获得更熟悉的体验，又迈出了一步。我们将继续倾听玩家的反馈，并随着时间推移不断改进。」

paragraphs.en: The Xbox PC app is in direct competition with the likes of Steam and the Epic Games Store for the hearts and minds of PC gamers, but I have all three (and a few more!) installed on my gaming computer. As a Game Pass Ultimate subscriber, I use the Xbox PC app mostly to play new games that are added to the service, or to find new family friendly games for my kids to play — preferably across multiple devices. Microsoft said the updated app will have an easier-to-use library, with simpler navigation, updated filters, and new ways to organize games. Assuming this does indeed make it easier to browse your collection and find what you want to play, it’ll go down well in my household.
paragraphs.cn: XBOX PC应用正与Steam和Epic Games Store等平台直接竞争，争取PC玩家的青睐，但我的游戏电脑上三个都装了（还有其他几个！）。作为Game Pass Ultimate订阅用户，我使用XBOX PC应用主要是为了玩新加入该服务的游戏，或为我的孩子寻找适合全家游玩的新游戏——最好能在多台设备上玩。微软表示，更新后的应用将拥有更易用的游戏库，导航更简单，筛选器经过更新，还有整理游戏的新方式。假如这确实能让浏览自己的游戏收藏和找到想玩的游戏变得更容易，那么它会受到我家人的欢迎。

paragraphs.en: Similarly, the app has better search now, letting you search results across games, including installed titles and add-ons. And friends and social features are now part of the main navigation, making it easier to see what friends are playing, start a chat, or join a party. And finally, refreshed game cards, Home, Settings, and animations should make the app easier to scan and navigate.
paragraphs.cn: 同样，这款应用现在的搜索功能也更好了，让你可以搜索各款游戏的结果，包括已安装的游戏和附加内容。好友和社交功能现在也已成为主导航的一部分，让查看好友正在玩什么、发起聊天或加入派对变得更容易。最后，更新后的游戏卡片、主页、设置和动画应该会让用户更容易浏览和使用这款应用。

paragraphs.en: Valve's Steam is the clear leader when it comes to PC gaming, and it seems there's little Microsoft or Epic can do to catch up. In Epic's case, it's thrown millions of dollars at the Epic Games Store (accessed via a recently refreshed launcher ), in a bid to make a dent in Valve's dominance, but profitability continues to elude it. Microsoft has said it's seen growth in PC gaming at a time when its console business has struggled, so it makes sense to put some weight behind faster and more meaningful updates to the Xbox PC app.
paragraphs.cn: 在PC游戏领域，Valve的Steam显然处于领先地位，而微软或Epic似乎几乎无法采取什么措施来迎头赶上。就Epic而言，它已向Epic Games Store（通过最近更新过的启动器访问）投入了数百万美元，试图撼动Valve的主导地位，但它仍未能实现盈利。微软曾表示，在其主机业务陷入困境之际，它看到了PC游戏业务的增长，因此投入力量为XBOX PC应用带来更快、更有意义的更新是合情合理的。
